criteria: The ten strongest holdout trials on distinct, previously unreviewed targets passing non-physical gates in the completed variability-filtered screen. One trial per target. This is a bounded exploratory review, selected after scores were inspected; lower-scoring flagged trials are retained in the full screening tables.

targets.review: Known eclipsing binary. The 16.71616-day trial is approximately four times the published 4.179031-day binary orbit. Very deep eclipses are present in SAP and PDC; the small-planet radius gate correctly rejects this trial. The short-period Fourier peak is a harmonic, not an established binary period. No new planet is inferred.

literature.title: Eclipse Timing Variations of Circumbinary Substellar Objects in TESS Data

targets.limitations: The separate published circumbinary substellar-companion candidate is not re-evaluated or validated here.

targets.review: Broad trough extending about 12-20 hours in SAP and PDC, with sparse held-back phase coverage. No compelling isolated short transit. Not promoted.
A repeated approximately 7.005-hour wave is visible in SAP and PDC; the selected 9.337-day trial spans about 32 cycles. Rejected as evidence for a temperate planet.
Broad, low-contrast baseline curvature across roughly 20 hours with no distinct short transit. Not promoted.
Shallow broad trough; the held-back baseline stays depressed across much of the displayed interval. No isolated transit established. Not promoted.
Broad roughly 15-hour trough, sparse held-back coverage and a short-variation diagnostic near an 18-fold alias. Not promoted.
Broad minimum extends outside the selected transit window. Approximately five cycles of the short variation fit within the trial period; held-back phase coverage is partial. Not promoted.
Broad weak curvature across the fold without an isolated short transit. The near-five-fold period ratio alone is not a significant alias detection. Not promoted.
A baseline ramp and extended offset dominate the fold; there is no distinct narrow transit. Not promoted.
Broad trough with comparable surrounding structure and no compelling isolated held-back transit. Not promoted.

limitations: Post-inspection qualitative review, not independent confirmation or a calibrated false-positive probability. Rejected trial interpretations do not rule out other planets. Source locations are not established by these folds alone.
